# The signer column: node judgments

[M] Lane repin-148, assigned Claude Opus 5.5 (pool, on the box); GitHub Calgooon. Runtime variant and tier are not independently exposed.

[D] Synthetic outpoints are judged by `verifyscript` with the corpus prevouts; no coins are funded and nothing is submitted or broadcast. Each signed engine transaction and the self-check's hand-signed control are judged under both derived words. Both columns use the oracle's zeroed policy caps (consensus limits); relay means the relay flag word, not mempool admission or default policy limits. Locktime/finality and fees are outside this script judgment. `stopOnFirstInvalid=false` judges every input. A trace is one input in one column; site digests are compared separately, once per signed method. The node exposes input verdicts, not per-site execution verdicts. Refusal counts count each transaction once per class; classes can overlap when different inputs fail for different reasons. The refused union is signed minus valid for each column.

[M] `signer self-consistency: GREEN [X] (241 api-scriptcode rows, 456 site digests equal, 0 unequal) (241 api-context-scriptcode rows, 456 site digests equal, 0 unequal) engine=bsv-rs`. This compares two callers of the same library digest primitives; it is a self-consistency check. Every signed result is separately judged by the node.

[SRC] bsv-rs 0.7.0 `src/script/template.rs:133-154` signs over the context's scriptCode, the locking script unless `with_script_code` (`:114-117`) supplies another (`:142`), through `compute_sighash_dispatched_for_signing` (`src/primitives/bsv/sighash.rs:970-976`), whose original digest returns constant one for SINGLE beyond outputs (`:983-992`). The 0.5.0 mechanisms that follow are history (#148): at 0.5.0 `src/script/template.rs:85-99` selected the source locking script and called the BIP143-only function `src/primitives/bsv/sighash.rs:941-944`; its dispatched function at `:962-983` selected the original digest for Chronicle and returned constant one for original SINGLE beyond outputs. The node selects scriptCode at bitcoin-sv v1.2.3 `6504a3af` `src/script/interpreter.cpp:1471-1481`, dispatches at `:2112-2124` and returns original SINGLE constant one at `:2086-2100`. [SRC] At 0.5.0 `src/primitives/bsv/sighash.rs:941-944` built the BIP143 preimage (`:384`, `SighashCache::preimage` `:546-570`) whose hashOutputs is 32 zero bytes for SINGLE beyond outputs (`SighashCache::hash_outputs` `:534-536`), whatever the CHRONICLE bit; the node returns constant one for the same scope (`interpreter.cpp:2086-2100`, `:2112-2124`).

[SRC] The public `unlock` paths are bsv-rs 0.7.0 `src/script/templates/p2pkh.rs:151` (`context.compute_sighash` `:162`), `src/script/templates/p2pk.rs:66` (`:76`) and `src/script/templates/multisig.rs:158` (`:169`). The options at `src/script/template.rs:209-217` (`compute_sighash_scope`, FORKID always) cannot express Chronicle or omit FORKID, so those template rows are unsigned. Transaction signing at `src/transaction/transaction.rs:1462` uses the same context.

[D] Class precedence is lock-only, constant-one, then Chronicle BIP143. In-unlock Chronicle rows can have both scriptCode and dispatch differences; the lock-only count is not proof that scriptCode is the sole cause. The Chronicle BIP143 marker requires scriptCode equal to the control and an exact BIP143 preimage/digest. Control refusals are separate classes: SIG_PUSHONLY (`interpreter.cpp:2321-2334`), ILLEGAL_CHRONICLE (`:296-303`) and MUST_USE_FORKID (`:296-306`) at the same node pin; they are not signer disagreements.
